item.description: ← Back to Blog Education Security Tokens Explained: What They Are and Why They Matter By Sails.to Team • January 10, 2026 • 10 min read If you've heard about cryptocurrency, you've probably encountered terms like "utility tokens," "NFTs," and "DeFi." item.title: The TradFi Bridge Explained: Connecting Blockchain to Traditional Finance
item.description: ← Back to Blog Technology The TradFi Bridge Explained: Connecting Blockchain to Traditional Finance By Sails.to Team • January 25, 2026 • 13 min read One of the most common barriers to institutional adoption of security tokens is custody. Banks, family offices, and funds have established custodians they trust. Asking them to self-custody on blockchain is often a non-starter. That's why we built the TradFi Bridge—enabling security tokens to exist simultaneously in both blockchain and traditional finance infrastructures.

item.title: Why Wyoming? The State Leading Crypto Innovation
item.description: ← Back to Blog Legal & Compliance Why Wyoming? The State Leading Crypto Innovation By Sails.to Team • January 15, 2026 • 8 min read When we decided to build Sails.to, one of our first decisions was where to incorporate. We chose Wyoming—and it wasn't just because of the scenery. Wyoming has quietly become the most crypto-friendly jurisdiction in the United States, passing over 30 blockchain-enabling laws since 2018.
